_note: Sales metrics in the pre-print log (routines/sales_metrics.py, Kilian 2026-11-13). Names valued on EV/sales (>= _sales_weight_min of the live set's horizon-multiple weight) get total revenue vs Zacks; names listed here get the metrics listed. actual_re: regex on the plain text of the 8-K Item 2.02 Ex.99.1 (first group, commas dropped) x actual_scale into the model unit ($M; fractions for rates). Street kinds: zacks_sales (Zacks quarter consensus), guide (company guide mid x usual beat, from the model's guidance_check), prior_reported (last reported figure, previous release). Ours kinds: revenue, revenue_less (revenue less a driver), driver, none.
